notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 27, 2025
notes.notes:
This patch contains a few small enhancements and a number of bug fixes.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Catapults have much better aim now
[*] Improved hockey mode camera
[*] Added ambient sound to main menu
[*] Added UI sounds
[*] Slightly improved gamepad button styles
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed timing and UI issues with narrator dialogue in ending cinematic
[*] Fixed random skating noises in Elfton
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dopplegangers would skate off the map
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes: This patch includes a fix for an issue where the player could fall through the top of the mountain.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
This patch includes a few bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would fall through the ground on Retry or Continue
[*] Fixed styles on Game Over screen
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1: Catapults, more enemies, and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Ahoy! This first update includes some more and different enemies to handle in Elfton as well as a few bug fixes.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added catapults to Elfton
[*] Added more elves to Elfton
[*] Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemies appearing out of thin air
[*] Fixed continue game flow
[/list]
